name: Strawberry Jelly 0.5g Live Rosin Disposable
description:
Lineage: Sour Strawberry x Jelly Breath
Type: Hybrid
Terpenes: Myrcene, Limonene, and Caryophyllene
Aroma: Like opening a jar of fresh strawberry-flavored jelly, complemented by hints of sour citrus, woody pine
Effects: Happy, uplifted, energized, and euphoric

Strawberry Jelly- sweet, saucy, and straight-up mood magic. Bred from Sour Strawberry x Jelly Breath, this hybrid smells like cracking open a jar of fresh strawberry jelly with a splash of sour citrus and pine. The high is happy, euphoric, and energizing-perfect for lifting spirits and keeping the good vibes spread thick.
